title: MCP list_actions still offers members identity actions they cannot run (invite_user, remove_member, delete_sso_provider, create_organization) after #30771
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced on a public entry (reach below).

QA-source: #32135 · ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

Reach: MCP `tools/call list_actions` as a plain member (`phone.demo`, `auditor.demo`) on the showcase at framework ff04ad81. The list includes `invite_user`, `remove_member`, `delete_sso_provider`, `create_organization` and others; `run_action invite_user` is then refused 403. #30771 (ruling A) made `list_actions` list only what the caller can run, reading each action's declared gate; these identity actions declare no gate, so they still appear.

## Proposed change

Declare the gate on the remaining identity actions (the same declaration #30771 introduced), so `list_actions` and REST `/actions` leave them out for callers who would be refused.

## Business reason

Who: AI agents operating an app over MCP. Cost: an agent plans around actions it will be refused, wasting turns and confusing users.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands where those actions are declared (`plugin-auth` / platform-objects identity actions).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack list_actions caller cannot run` (49, open and closed): #30771 and #28943 (closed) fixed the mechanism and one case; this is the remaining set.
